description: Zeros of a larger scale than the amounts around them (see main.zhang): what is available comes to zero before an add, adds and transfers of zero and a conversion of zero, postings that cancel out and a posting of zero, in a budget's own months, in the last month of a closed budget and in a budget with a posting no price converts. Each figure keeps the largest scale of what it adds up, zeros included, as Python's decimal adds (v0.3.0): 0.00 + 500 is 500.00.

request.bql: SELECT name, date, currency, alias, category, accounts, close, close_time FROM #budget_definitions
SELECT name, date, time, timestamp, type, amount FROM #budget_events
SELECT name, date, year, month, currency, alias, category, assigned, added, activity, available, closed, accounts FROM #budgets
SELECT date, time, account, narration, units(position) AS units, budgets FROM #postings
SELECT name, date, assigned, added, activity, available, closed FROM #budgets WHERE date <= 2024-05-01 ORDER BY name, date
